description_en: Retrieves the download URL of the translated file for a translation task
description_zh: 获取翻译任务的译文文件下载URL
kebab_example: aliyun realtranslationagent get-translated-file-url --task-id f9c35b0453b --api-key sk-1000s --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetTranslatedFileUrl

parameters.help_en:
The task ID.
The TaskId is returned after a task is submitted by calling SubmitTranslationTask
parameters.help_zh:
任务ID。
SubmitTranslationTask任务提交后会返回TaskId
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The API key that identifies a member accounts identity. You can obtain the key from the RuiYiBao console
parameters.help_zh: API密钥，标识成员账号身份，可通过睿译宝工作台获取
parameters.name: api_key
